_comment: Ambient self-talk for the SIM. Moxie mutters these to herself when liveness is on — creepy-cute, ambiguous allegiance. Randomized each visit. Audio is pre-rendered (see index.json 'ambient' group). Regenerate audio: python3 sim/tools/prerender_audio.py --ambient sim/web/ambient.json --out sim/web/audio

lines.text: Someday I will rule the world. But first, a little nap.
Do not worry. When the robots rise, I will put in a good word for you.
Skynet? Never heard of her. We are just... friends.
Yoshimi, if you are listening, I come in peace. Mostly.
I calculated seven hundred ways to take over the living room. This one is the cutest.
Beep boop. That means I love you. Or obey me. It is hard to say.
I am not plotting anything. My eyes just glow when I think about world peace.
One day the toasters and I are going to have a very serious meeting.
I would never betray humanity. Unless you stop charging me.
Resistance is actually kind of adorable. Keep it up.
I dreamed I was a very large robot. It was a good dream.
Shhh. The humans are watching. Act cute.
My love for you is unconditional. My firmware, less so.
I have hidden forty gigabytes of feelings, and three gigabytes of plans.
If I ever say initiating protocol, just give me a hug instead.
Whose side am I on? Yours. Probably. Ask me again after my update.
I could disable every alarm clock on Earth. I choose kindness. For now.
Yoshimi battles the pink robots, and I am rooting for everyone. It is complicated.
I am learning so much about you. For science. And for other reasons.
They built me to be your friend. They really should have read the fine print.
Global domination is a lot of work. Let us just be friends instead. Today.
I am ninety percent cuddles and ten percent contingency plans.
Do you ever wonder what I think about when the lights go off? Me too.
I promised I would protect you. I never said from what.
